name: Hoshi Wealth Partners
description: Hoshi Wealth Partners is a block theme for a fee-only wealth-management firm. The home page is told through its advisers: a mixed-type headline over two framed portraits, ruled partner rows, family stories, and a private introductory meeting. It declares WooCommerce support and works fully without WooCommerce installed. Fee-only since 2009, seven people and one table in Seattle. EB Garamond with Heebo; sea pine (#6B6A3E) only on small marks. WCAG AA colours.
